{{Quote|Corellia is our home. We have defended the planet for generations.|Den mother Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
The [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Murthil]] was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of a [[Den (Selonian)|'''den''']] of Selonian [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who resided in the [[Selonian Tunnels|Selonian Tunnel Network]] under the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].

==History==
===Denizens===
{{Quote|Everyone on Corellia knows the name Murthil. My den has defended this planet for many years.|Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
[[File:Murthil2.png|thumb|224px|Murthil was a strong Selonian den mother]]
Led by the fearsome [[den mother]] [[Murthil]] in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the den, by then, had defended their [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and was known to [[Corellian/Legends|surface-dwellers]] only by rumors of their existence in a vast [[Selonian Tunnels|Selonian Tunnel Network]] under [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. There, they lived in inter-connected [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] either dug out of Corellia's rocks or were formed from a network of pre-established underground pipelines.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

===Invasion===
{{Quote|Republic, Empire... politics mean nothing to Selonians. We fight because you invade our home.|Murthil, to an Empire-aligned individual|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], forces of the latter invaded Corellia and rooted out Republic loyalists, resistance fighters, as well as the native Selonians from their homes. Angered by this intrusion, the Corellian Selonians, led by den mother Murthil, aided resistance fighters fleeing from the surface and provided shelter for those affected by the attempted Imperial occupation.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

====Bulwarks====
{{Quote|For the den! For Corellia!|Murthil rallies her Selonians|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
During the struggle for independence from Imperial forces, the Seloians became a major target for housing rebels in the Tunnel Network beneath Coronet [[City/Legends|City's]] [[Labor Valley]]. By the orders of the Imperial commander&mdash;[[Darth Decimus]]&mdash;an Imperial strike team had been dispatched to pursue the remaining rebel forces and confront den mother Murthil for her assistance to the rebellion.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

In Murthil's tunnels, Imperial forces struck down many Selonian warriors as they made their way to Murthil's bunker, where the mother and her [[Elite Selonian Guard]]s lay prepared behind a [[Force-field generator|Force Field Generator]].<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

====Fall====
{{Quote|Please... my sept deserves life. Show mercy, and we follow the Empire.|Defeated, Murthil pleads for mercy|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
[[File:Imperial_Guard_Selonian_Uprising.png|thumb|left|224px|Imperial forces brought an end to the Selonian uprising]]
Still commanding her den from the bunker, Murthil was faced with an Imperial hero as she conferred with the elite guard [[Destha]]. Calling for the Imperials' surrender, the Selonians were ready for combat nonetheless, and a fight eventually ensued.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

Rallying her warriors in the chamber, the Selonians battled, though they were no match for the Imperial hero. Downed and defeated, Murthil was accepting her den's downfall when three [[Imperial Guard]]s entered, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hesker]] amongst them. Congratulating the Imperial hero's work, Hesker relayed [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Decimus' wishes for the fate of the Selonians to fall in the hero's hands.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

{{GameDS}}
The fate of Corellia's Selonians was decided by the Imperial when Murthil was executed&mdash;"we'll kill every last Selonian on Corellia."<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />
{{Endgame}}

==Members==
{{Quote|War is in our blood. Violence against the den is not smart.|Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
[[File:Destha.png|thumb|224px|Destha was an Elite Selonian Guard of Murthil's den]]
Murthil's Selonian den consisted of many warriors, including the Elite Selonian Guards. Selonian warriors populated the [[Selonian Tunnels|tunnel network]] of pipelines beneath Coronet City, with the more elite warriors such as armsmasters standing guard nearer to the den mother's tunnels and its bunker, where the Elite Guard, including the twin-[[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]-wielding Selonian Destha, protected den mother Murthil.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The fleeing rebels slowed us. I had to cut through the tide to reach you. We flanked the den and caved in the tunnels behind us. The rebels' transportation network is crushed. As for the Selonians, Darth Decimus leaves their fate in your hands.|General Hesker speaks to the Imperial player|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
Murthil's den's first and only appearance is in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

When faced with the choice of either killing or capturing Murthil, the player could take the option of sparing the Selonians, allowing Murthil to swear allegiance to the Empire. Before she is taken into Imperial custody, the den mother explains that per Selonians traditions, promises were always kept.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

Later, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tradik]], an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who initially advocated for assaulting the "flurry [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]"&mdash;the Selonians&mdash;in their tunnels as news of their collaboration with resistance forces reached his ear and who served as Darth Decimus' liaison to Imperial forces at Labor Valley, would report to the player of the aftermath of Murthil's capture through an in-game mail, with 3018 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] attached:<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

{{ExcerptIU|My men are rounding up Murthil's hairy kin as we speak. Whatever you did down there, it worked--they're perfectly docile now.<br /><br />We'll put the beasts to work making maps for our commando units, then ship them out for labor details wherever they're needed.<br /><br />Nice bit of work.
|attrib="Selonians," by Major Tradik<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />
}}
